issue.title: Bob command mode: press : in Obsidian to run bob
issue.description: Pressing `:` in Obsidian's Vim normal mode opens a fast, beautiful bob command sheet. The user filters a bob-owned catalog of every useful bob command, runs one with context-aware arguments and safe-write guards, and is notified when it finishes, with three honest outcome classes (completed, needs attention, failed). The full output is always one key away in a pager that doubles as run history. Vim's own ex line stays reachable through `::`, Vim-shaped input, and `g:`.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/bob_colon_command_mode.md requests this work
